newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 3-yr bond yields close slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 3-yr bond yields close slightly higher.

text.p: The benchmark three-year corporate yields closed slightly higher on Monday despite the central bank's supply of two trillion won to the banking system, dealers said.
The three-month CD yields closed lower on relatively scanty new issues, they said.
Overnight call rate rose as the short-term cash liquidity tightened ahead of huge tax payments due on Tuesday.
* 3-yr corporates close at 12.07 pct vs Saturday's 12.06
* 3-mth CDs end at 12.65 pct vs Saturday's 12.70
* Average overnight call rate at 13.0 pct vs Saturday's 12.5
